description: The plot titled “Training Loss of 20M Data Size” illustrates training loss as a function of training step for six model configurations (ChemBART, ChemBERTa, and ChemLLaMA, each in Small and Medium sizes). The x-axis is labeled “Step” and uses a linear scale with tick labels at 0k, 20k, 40k, 60k, and 80k, followed by a visual axis break and a second linear segment labeled at 420k, 430k, and 440k. The y-axis is labeled “Train Loss” on a linear scale and shows a broken range: a lower segment with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4, and an upper segment with labeled ticks at 0.75 and 0.85. All six series are drawn as solid lines with no markers: the red line (ChemBART Small 20M) starts near the upper y-segment around ~0.8 at the earliest steps, drops steeply into the lower segment within the first several thousand steps, is near ~0.20 by roughly 20k, trends down to about ~0.10 by ~80k, and in the far-right segment (420k–440k) stays around ~0.04–0.05; the blue line (ChemBART Medium 20M) begins near ~0.8, declines rapidly to roughly ~0.20 by ~20k, is around ~0.09–0.10 by ~80k, and is around ~0.04 in the 420k–440k window; the green line (ChemBERTa Small 20M) starts near ~0.8, falls quickly below 0.4 early on, is around ~0.22–0.24 near ~20k, approaches ~0.11 by ~80k, and sits near ~0.05 around 420k–440k; the orange line (ChemBERTa Medium 20M) begins near ~0.8, decreases sharply early, is near ~0.20 around ~20k, reaches roughly ~0.08–0.09 by ~80k, and lies around ~0.04–0.05 over 420k–440k; the purple line (ChemLLaMA Small 20M) starts near ~0.8, drops quickly to about ~0.17–0.18 by ~20k, moves down to roughly ~0.07–0.08 by ~80k, and is around ~0.03–0.04 in the 420k–440k range; the brown line (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) likewise starts near ~0.8, declines steeply to roughly ~0.15–0.16 by ~20k, reaches about ~0.06–0.07 by ~80k, and stays near ~0.03–0.04 between ~420k and ~440k, with small high-frequency fluctuations visible along all lines throughout the plotted steps.
